title: Calico private archive latest-transaction discovery pointer (v1)
description: Closed, fixed-key, append-only discovery pointer written by calico_capture.archive.synchronize_verified_transaction (2026-09-03 code review, CR-01 fix) at archive/v1/latest-transaction-pointer.json. Unlike every other document this archive writes, this key is a deliberate, documented exception to the archive's otherwise strictly immutable, content-addressed key space: it carries a new provider-kept version every time a newer transaction is synchronized, so a caller with no local state (a fresh calico_capture.orchestrator.capture() working store) can discover the safe release identity of the single most recently archived transaction via calico_capture.archive.read_latest_transaction_pointer, without any prefix-listing capability. It is never the source of truth for any individual transaction's own validity -- that always remains the transaction's own read-back-verified manifest (private-archive-v1.schema.json) -- and is only ever advanced forward, never regressed by an out-of-order synchronize call.
